plain: A judge whose marks run consistently high (lenient) or low (severe) compared with everyone else's.
eli5: The teacher who gives everyone a gold star, and the one who never does.
technical: A constant offset in a rater's scores, or equivalently an effective pass cut below (lenient) or above (severe) the policy's. It can coexist with perfect ranking (unchanged AUC); read it off the YES rate against a labelled set.
